description: The node's bundles, each a named subset of the API, keyed by a number, each with an owner: "node" or the name of an app server. An app server's bundles come from its Bundles.json at boot; a caller makes and deletes node-owned ones alone. op add {label, owner?} answers {id}, owned by node (an owner naming an app server is refused not-node-owned, an invalid one is read as node), its label unique among node's bundles (label-taken); a bundle's label and owner are the add's and never change after, and set is refused; delete {id} removes a node-owned one and every branch that names it; get {id} answers {id, label, owner}; search {text, owner?} answers {items, more}, an owner narrowing it to that owner's bundles. A label is never empty. Its branches are auth.branch's.
